art_note: The product flat shots are clean, but the lifestyle model images look composited and cheap, lowering the overall luxury perception.
desc_en: A one-piece swimwear piece designed with a refined tropical motif and a cross-wrap waist silhouette. Scalloped ruffle edges introduce a fluid accent to the structure. Crafted from smooth-touch polyester fabric. Adjustable straps allow for a precise fit. Each piece is made to order and available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una pieza de baño diseñada con un refinado motivo tropical y silueta cruzada en la cintura. Los bordes con volantes aportan un acento fluido a la estructura. Confeccionado en tejido de poliéster de tacto suave. Las tiras ajustables permiten un ajuste preciso. Cada pieza se elabora bajo pedido y cuenta con envío mundial.
